summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for StockQuest/Candy Kingdom. 25/25 pytest tests passed covering all REST endpoints (state, fund, buy-request auto+pending, approve, deny, redeem, quest-complete, limits, reset, AI story, AI quests) AND Socket.IO WebSocket lifecycle (connect, join_room+state_update, price_tick every ~2s, trade_executed/pending_added/trade_approved events, multi-client room broadcast). All flows working correctly including AI integration with Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations.

minor.issue: Initial state coins (680) is too low for the 'pending' threshold demo scenario described in context (100 AAPL candies = 1200 coins > 680). User/UI flow needs to call /api/fund before triggering pending demo. Tests handle this by funding first, but the demo script should do likewise.

When AI fallback path triggers, response returns DEFAULT_QUESTS WITHOUT progress=0/done=False reset (uses .copy() of the constants which already include those fields - OK). Verified shape is well-formed JSON in both paths.

action_items: No action items - all backend tests pass. Backend is grant-demo ready.

Note for frontend: the Kid view must fund the wallet before allowing 100-candy AAPL buys, OR the demo must show the 2 pre-seeded pending items rather than rely on creating new ones from default state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~535 line file containing models, socket handlers, REST routes, AI calls. Acceptable for single-session demo but consider splitting into routers/services if scope grows.
_initial_state() uses datetime.now() inside the constant so each reset has fresh timestamps - good.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in get_state() and via state.pop('_id', None) in save_state() - good.
price_ticker_loop catches all Exceptions and continues - good resiliency.
AI endpoints both have graceful fallback to deterministic content when LLM call fails - good.
Pydantic validation present on FundReq (amount_usd>0,<=10000) and BuyReq (candies>0,<=1000). LimitsReq lacks bounds validation (could accept negative auto_approve_under). Minor.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec but acceptable for demo.
seed_data_creation: Each test auto-resets state via /api/reset autouse fixture so tests are independent. No persistent seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_stockquest_backend.py covers all REST + Socket.IO flows. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_stockquest_backend.py -v. Initial coins=680 is below what's needed for default-state pending demos with AAPL/GOOGL/TSLA - tests fund the wallet first when needed. price_ticker continuously mutates DB every 2s so timing-sensitive tests must tolerate price drift. AI endpoints take 2-5s; fallback paths verified working.
